component.name: AllInOne PDF
component.summary: Convert, read, style and lay out PDFs, all offline

description.p: AllInOne PDF turns files into PDFs and PDFs into files: Markdown, HTML, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, EPUB, plain text, images, CSV, JSON and source code in; PDF, Markdown, HTML, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, text and page images out. Every conversion goes through one document model, so any source becomes any target.

It also reads any of those formats in a comfortable reflowable view, styles PDFs with 28 built-in themes and a theme builder, and lays out publications in the Creator, a page builder with structured rows and columns or a free-flow canvas. Everything runs offline in pure .NET: no network, no telemetry, no external programs.
